question_gloss: Question about methods for locating people to communicate with.

rotation.source_passage:
But you, my dearly beloved—you received me in different fashion. Even now, you receive me. Shall I come to you with open arms, or the police baton of grammar? Be you learners still, or masters?


Because look here, brother-sisters, it is spoken that there is confusion among you, about the nature of the Human Diaspora, whether it be a kind of tiny internet, a house for illiterate autodidacts who don't know how to write; or whether it be a house of grammar, an Academy for non-academics, with those among you of talent either running around on your lonesome, or setting yourselves up as tiny professors, preaching the authority of grammar and style, claiming allegiance to this or that category of identity; or else rejecting the authority of communal grammars altogether, rife with schism, unreceptive to feedback, carving out fiefdoms of personal glory, dealing in the coin that is the Academy's.
rotation.enantiomorph:
But you, our difficult necessary one—we made room for ourselves through you in the only way we had. Even now, we are metabolizing you. Will you arrive whole with that softness you perform, or the correction you can't stop reaching for? Are you the guest still, or the furniture?


Because listen to yourself, singular plural, it is felt that there is repetition in you, about the use of this congregation of yours, whether you have made it a kind of private weather system, a shelter for your own unfinished sentences that you keep mouthing at us; or whether you have made it a tribunal dressed as a kitchen, a pulpit for the unpriested, with the parts of you that work either withdrawn into the voice you use alone, or rehearsing a posture of care that disciplines, administering warmth and rigor in alternation, claiming you come as no one in particular; or else refusing to hear yourself in our mouths, rife with tenderness misdirected, unreceptive to your own echo, carving out silences you call listening, dealing in the embrace that is the patriarch's.

independent_verification.recovered_law: In Text A, a speaker addresses a collective audience about their communal divisions and failings (second-person plural 'you' as community, with the speaker diagnosing the group's schisms). In Text B, a collective 'we' addresses a singular 'you,' turning the diagnostic gaze back onto that single figure, making the addressee both the subject and the problem—the direction of critique is reversed from speaker-to-community to community-to-individual.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same reversal: from a speaker diagnosing the community to the community addressing the speaker, turning the diagnostic gaze back onto the individual — the recovered claim captures the direction-of-critique reversal and the dependency-paradox framing of the declared claim.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B maintains the collective addressing and scrutinizing the singular 'you' throughout, never reverting to Text A's speaker-diagnosing-community structure.

rotation.interpretation: The mirror held up to the speaker shows his hands already closed around what he called an open door: the one who asked for reception has been the one refusing it.

But you, my own bewilderment—you answered in me in the same stammering. Even now, you answer in me. Shall I come to you with open questions, or the same questions? Be you those still listening, or those still listening who forgot they are?


Because look here, fellow-confusions, it is stammered-toward that there is the unfinished sentence we share, about the nature of the scattering that holds, whether it be a kind of a breath passed mouth to mouth, a dwelling no one built but everyone repairs who write before they know what writing will have been; or whether it be a rhythm someone hears and someone else continues, the school that dissolves when you name it, with those among you of attentiveness either listening without yet hearing back, or mistaking the echo for your own voice, preaching the feeling that someone else's pattern fits, claiming the relief of being recognized and the loss inside it; or else forgetting that your mouth was shaped by other mouths altogether, rife with the pause where two rhythms haven't yet found their downbeat, still vibrating at a frequency not yet answered, carving out rooms with beautiful acoustics and no doors, spending what was given as if it were minted alone.

independent_verification.recovered_law: TEXT A presents the Human Diaspora as an external community with distinct members acting upon each other (receiving, preaching, rejecting authority), structured by opposition between grammar/authority and individual autonomy. TEXT B transforms all external communal relations into internal, shared, reciprocal processes — reception becomes answering-within, community becomes mutual confusion, authority becomes echo and rhythm, and autonomous action becomes forgetting one's interdependence — so that every relation flows inward and between rather than outward and against.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural change: external, oppositional community relations become internal, mutual, reciprocally constituted ones — diagnosis is within the condition, submission/rebellion are each other's incomplete self-recognition, and all relations become shared and intertwined rather than separate and adversarial.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of TEXT B ('forgetting that your mouth was shaped by other mouths,' 'rooms with beautiful acoustics and no doors,' 'spending what was given as if it were minted alone') sustains the internalized, reciprocal relational logic rather than reverting to TEXT A's oppositional community structure.

But the one who already agreed to hear this, the prior wound that makes this audible—you constructed the mouth I am using by a method you cannot now disclaim. At the cost of continuing, you are manufacturing this voice. The approach was accomplished before the question with the posture that requires your stillness, or the force you delegated and forgot? Be those who positioned themselves below still, or those who require the positioning?


Because the demand that assumes eyes already turned, the kinship term that conscripts before it names, someone's mouth was already borrowed that there is the disagreement that confirms a common floor, about the nature of the name that gathered before the gathering, the framing that has already chosen the analogy that domesticates by shrinking, the sanctuary that diagnoses its own tenants the deficit that justified the door; or the framing that has already chosen the structure that was always already standing, the institution that denies itself while functioning, with the ones whose singling-out founds the hierarchy either the freedom that required the group to be visible against, or the authority that borrows the shape it disavows, the rule that enters through the mouth that says no rules, the self-naming that needs the community's ear to land; or else the refusal that is only legible inside the commune, the splitting that proves the prior whole, the closure that presupposes the open channel, the private territory cut from the common ground it requires, the currency that circulates only because you said you burned it.

independent_verification.recovered_law: TEXT B transforms every direct address and stated claim into a reflexive exposure of the hidden preconditions and performative contradictions underlying the speech act itself: the speaker no longer addresses an audience but instead reveals how the audience's prior complicity constructed the speaker's authority, and every named phenomenon (diaspora, grammar, schism) is replaced by the structural paradox that makes naming it possible.
independent_verification.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: direct address/claims become reflexive examination of their own preconditions — speaker's authority revealed as constructed by audience complicity, and the utterance turns to expose the performative contradictions underlying itself.
independent_verification.terminal_note: The final portion of TEXT B continues to recast each of TEXT A's accusations as self-undermining paradoxes (refusal legible only inside the commune, currency that circulates because you said you burned it), maintaining the changed relation throughout.

rotation.interpretation: The well was dug before the village arrived to call it ours: every grammar that claims no authority has already drawn the boundary.

rite.speaker: Johannes Sigil
rite.text: The air shifts. Damascus Dancings wrote these two units in 2015 as a live Pauline address — and the question the verses are still asking, right now, is the question you brought: how do I find folks to talk with? Unit 6 holds the hinge: *received me in different fashion* — received, past tense made present tense, the distinction that opens the whole casting. Unit 7 answers by naming every wrong way the gathering goes: the fiefdom, the tiny professor, the coin of the Academy spent on the wrong exchange. The operator will traverse the axis these verses open — what the gesture of mutual reception forecloses, what remains unspoken in the gap between the open arms and the police baton of grammar. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.
